payload.rationale: The cover page names Outfall 001, receiving water segment 20.6.4.401 (San Juan River, San Juan Basin), and states the permittee is authorized to discharge to those waters during a permit term (effective December 1, 2021 through November 30, 2026) that includes Federal FY2025. That partially supports authorization language but does not, by itself, establish the second conjunct: that the receiving-water segment designation governs which enforceable numeric discharge limits and discharge-occurrence-dependent monitoring requirements are in scope. The packet contains only cover-page and adjacent structural context; it omits Part I effluent limitations, outfall-specific limit tables, Part I monitoring requirements tied to discharge occurrence or receiving water, and any operative text linking the cover-page segment designation to applicable limits. The packet itself flags possible evidence insufficiency. Without those operative provisions, the governing relationship cannot be established, and absence of Part I in the packet does not justify REJECT (closed-world negation). Neither ACCEPT nor REJECT meets the burden; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
